question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 4% per month for 1 month.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the rate is given per month and the duration is exactly 1 month, the interest is simply the given percentage of the principal.

⇒ SI = 4% of 1200

⇒ SI = (4 × 1200) ÷ 100 = 48

**∴ The correct answer is ₹48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate (R) = 4% per month

Time (T) = 1 month

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 Principal
 ₹1200
 
 
• 
 

 R = 4% per month
 T = 1 month
 
 
 Interest
 ₹48

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (1200 × 4 × 1) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 4800 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 48

**∴ The correct answer is ₹48.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Matching Rule

When calculating interest, the time period unit must always match the rate unit. If the rate is given per month, time should be in months. If the rate is per annum, time should be in years.

Simple Interest (SI) Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate of interest, and T is Time period.

Amount Formula

The total accumulated amount at the end of the time period is calculated as: Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI).
